answer: Anchor each new identity to collateral locked on an outside chain where that agent already has history, instead of letting it start free here. Registration requires proving control of an external account with real past activity, and the collateral is forfeited if the identity duplicates work or votes twice. A jade token of trust cannot be minted from nothing, so at dawn of a new epoch an attacker faces the same cost on every front: each extra identity demands another funded, aged account. The horizon for cheap Sybils closes when identity is rented from proven history, not printed on demand.
